initial_checkpoints: Original default-trained 68M B0, paired by seed
state: One pooled problem vector, original-token cross-attention, shared residual MLP, native-logit anchored correction
promotion: Four-step refinement must beat its own zero/one-step predictions and the matched full-finetuning reset-state control on both seeds. Report actual source-inclusive costs and every proof-depth group.
interpretation: Exploratory R2 screen after frozen-head failures, not an isolated ablation or confirmation. Both encoder and original head may change during training. No test/private reserve scoring.
